title: A patch on a document that has a duplicate key behind an alias key is an error and changes nothing
notes: A document with a duplicate key is not valid YAML (YAML 1.2.2 section 3.2.1.1), however the duplicate is written: here the key `*a` names the same node as the first key `foo`, with forty other keys between. A library that reads a document for editing must judge it as the loader does; one that accepts it has a document it cannot address by pointer. The patch itself is harmless.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend accepted the document when it read it for editing, and applied the patch.
